channel.title: Thoughts from QuantumColleagues
channel.description: One thought about AI a week, for people running small and regulated businesses. Plain, practical ideas, no jargon.

item.title: Change the model. Keep the rules.
item.description: Bracton is the deterministic framework Admin Core runs inside. The model drafts, Bracton decides what’s allowed, and the rules stay put when the model changes.

item.title: Which AI can care providers trust?
item.description: Our care AI study on Isambard-AI is up and running. It tests which open models handle care admin well and safely on a provider’s own hardware.

item.title: The will is there. What’s often missing is a map.
item.description: 84% of young people who aren’t working, studying or training want to be. Career & Beyond, our free careers app, helps them map their next step.

item.title: We’ve been awarded 10,000 GPU hours on Isambard-AI
item.description: The UK’s national AI supercomputer will help us find the best open models for care work, using synthetic data only, so the evidence is ready for a National Care Service.

item.title: In regulated markets, wrap every AI model in rules it cannot bend
item.description: AI models are probabilistic, so every QuantumColleagues agent works inside a deterministic framework. Each action passes a fixed check, and a named person signs off anything with consequence.

item.title: A day with the team
item.description: One ordinary day with our AI colleagues: the overnight inbox, a policy answer with its source, training certificates flagged, and a daily report held until the manager signs it off.

item.title: Capacity that gives back
item.description: Two CEOs who think they're doing enough, a regulated team that hit a wall at Copilot, and how that work funds free career planning and post-AI training.

item.title: Transformation using AI: Rule Zero
item.description: A school woodwork lamp, three rules for starting with AI, and the one that comes before them all: write down your constraints first.

item.title: A National Care Service is coming. The admin is already here.
item.description: The Prime Minister has promised a National Care Service. While the organisation and funding are worked out, we show how Admin Core puts more of a care budget on care and less on admin.

item.title: First steps toward simplifying with agents and AI don’t need to be tricky.
item.description: Three rules we learned inside regulated UK businesses: pick one task, write down the boundaries, and run a two week trial on live work. Five pages.

item.title: People decide. Agent colleagues do the work.
item.description: We designed our agent threshold model to ensure that anything with real world consequences stops with a named person. Three pages on how it works.

item.title: You don’t need to burn cloud tokens on every job.
item.description: Most agentic automation wants rules, orchestration and a model on your own kit. Save the big models for judgement.
